banners.prompt:
Create a square bonus graphic for a sales page, FULL BLEED: the coloured background fills the whole square edge to edge, no white margins, no borders, no frame, no empty white space.
BACKGROUND: warm orange #F28C28 (title line 2 in deep green instead of orange) with a soft warm glow; title in white with the second line in orange.
LAYOUT: text block in the upper half, left-aligned with about 7% margins; a large, attractive 3D-style visual in the lower half: an open thick book with small floating white icons rising from the pages (folder, mouse, wifi, padlock, envelope).
TEXT (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Small label at the top, orange pill with white text: "🎁 БОНУС"
2) Title line 1, very big: "РЕЧНИК НА" (spelled Р-Е-Ч-Н-И-К, the fifth letter is И)
3) Title line 2, very big: "КОМПЮТЪРНИТЕ ДУМИ"
4) Subtitle, medium: "100 думи, обяснени просто"
Text must be BIG: the title lines take about 30% of the image height in total.
STYLE: premium, warm, friendly, modern; clean professional design like a bestselling publisher would use. Palette: deep green #1E7A4C, warm orange #F28C28, warm cream #FFF6E8 and white.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic except "E.A.S.Y." and "Windows". Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation and quotation marks. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Heavy, clean sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style) for titles; clean regular sans-serif for the subtitle. Large and clearly legible on a phone.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, author names or website addresses anywhere. Any screen content is simple shapes and icons with no readable text.
NO people, no faces.
